calibration.selection: minimum validation loss, never calibration test

gate.H1_dev: at least2/3 aligned seeds relative nMSE gain>=10% vs fixed_matched AND learned mean nMSE<=0.05 at800 updates
gate.H2_dev: digits8 mean loss within +0.02 nat/label, worst task loss increase<=0.05, accuracy deficit<=0.01 versus calibration-chosen strongest non-private native; require all3 seeds
gate.fresh_open: only if BOTH development H1 and H2 plus correctness checks pass; otherwise no fresh; need explicit new frozen fresh runner
gate.native_alias: same mathematical operator means no new Mirror-specific function class, independent of learning success

hypothesis: Shared learned rotation planes improve joint task learning versus fixed planes; compare native methods and actual payloads.

native_definitions.fixed: independently calibrated fixed-plane method; stronger optimization control
native_definitions.fixed_matched: same initial complete model and hyperparameters as selected learned except axes frozen; primary H1 comparator
native_definitions.householder: two task-specific trainable reflection normals, native HRA-style control, not full paper replication
native_definitions.native4: rank4 learned multiplicative feature dictionary plus four task coefficients
native_definitions.private_ffn: shared up plus full per-task up delta and per-task output head, common trunk/down

optimization.schedule: constant learning rates; freeze axis updates during warmup

planned_deviations: Resolved nonlinear synthetic teacher details prospectively; matrix-bank nMSE from old linear TCSMA is not directly compared.

Added fixed_matched alongside independently tuned fixed to isolate axes rather than hyperparameter changes.
Long continuation is prospectively assigned from calibration to learned/fixed_matched/best-native in aligned/digits8, not selected after development.
Exact native two-reflection alias is a numerical/autograd check rather than redundant training.
No routed MoE, no phase B/C, no official MA701 status replacement; full paper HRA reproduction not claimed.
scope: Phase A only; no new MA ID; no alignment/private addition in primary candidate

worlds.aligned: 12 nonlinear functions sharing unknown four arbitrary overlapping planes; hidden32 input24 output6; random teacher separate from initialization
worlds.digits: sklearn 1797 8x8 digit images; 60/20/20 stratified image-ID splits; pixels divided by16; eight named binary tasks and a separate four complementary tasks
worlds.digits_trunk: 64-48-GELU-32-GELU, trainable jointly; one trunk call per batch
worlds.partial: same shared teacher except last of six outputs replaced by independent per-task nonlinear teacher
